# The Memory Merchant

The Memory Merchant's boxes were said to be enchanted.

Some claimed... they could hear... the whispers...

of the past...

while others... swore they felt...

the presence...

of the one who owned the memory...

The merchant... never spoke...

of his past...

his origins...

his motivations...

only... the price...

of his memories...

*pauses*

A young... woman... approached him with a hesitant... smile...

She asked... to buy a memory...

one that... would change her life...

The Memory Merchant... looked... at her with eyes... that saw beyond... the surface...

and said... "I have... just the thing..."

*rummages through boxes*

Ah here it is A memory... of flying...

over... the stars...

on a winged... horse...

*hands her a box*

This one is 10 years old *the woman's eyes... widen*

Do you want to experience... it?
